text:
rachel_sales: Heads-up: ArcadiaLabs RFP landed. Needs: private deployment in EU, customer HSM (FIPS), mandatory PII scrubbing at source OR cryptographic guarantee no plaintext exits. They want capability matrix + 2-week POC plan + ballpark pricing by Thu. Can SE/SRE support?

diego_se: Copy. Can you paste the exact clause and link? Need to know if deterministic tokenization is required for matching.

rachel_sales: Link: https://arcadialabs.example/rfp/arcadia-2026.pdf. Excerpt: "Personal data must be removed or irreversibly tokenized before leaving client network unless HSM ensures vendor never accesses plaintext." POC focus: messaging + attachments + logs.

sam_sre: We can offer three paths: 1) client-side SDK tokenization, 2) Private in-customer subnet with HSM proxy (KMIP), 3) fully on-prem appliance. Option 2 needs peering + control-plane policy. ETA to provision once creds + CIDRs: 24-72h.

diego_se: POC deliverables I suggest listing: demo flow, attach handling with redaction, throughput smoke (50 rps), E2E logs proving no cleartext, integration runbook.

claire_fin: Preliminary price placeholders: POC (2w) $11k, Dedicated EU $6k/mo, Private install $48k + $7k/mo, On-prem appliance +$90k. Draft only.

zara_legal: Legal: if Arcadia requires zero vendor key access, we'll need on-prem SOW and different liability terms. Also confirm if their procurement accepts SOC2 + pen-test summary; if not, expect extra evidence requests.

attachments-bot: uploaded "arcadia-rfp.pdf" and "arcadia-capmatrix-v0.1.csv" to thread (internal links).

rachel_sales: Thanks. Action items: Diego - update capmatrix with 3 paths + deliverables by Wed EOD. Sam - provide firewall snippet and provisioning ETA. Claire - validate prices with pricing ops by Wed morning. Zara - review RFP legal language and flag contract changes. I'll schedule a security sync with Arcadia for Thu 10am CET.

diego_se: On it. I'll add a tiny SDK snippet for tokenization to the matrix.

sam_sre: Firewall snippet (example): ```
# allow redwood proxy
allow tcp 443 from redwood-admin to arcadia-vpc
# control plane
allow tcp 10250:10255 from redwood-control to arcadia-admin
```

rachel_sales: Great, thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update once the legal sync is complete.
